global_invariants: External prose uses C10; native chapter-fact content does not use C10.
Native chapter-fact content never returns to M2 or M3.
WORK_DRAFT prose semantics cannot be reused for chapter-fact content.
C11 owns stable chapter_id and formal revision_no only after successful commit.
No caller may fabricate chapter_id, revision_no, fact_id, timestamps, titles, or complete plan-card fields.
Scheme-A INITIAL title is author-confirmed, single-line, trimmed, and never guessed or defaulted.
AuthorWorkspace and planstore are separate physical commits; pending and recovery states must remain visible.
T14 completed means judgment coverage is complete, not all-clear.
Unknown author adjudication is an overlay and never rewrites the original unknown judgment.
Empty or whitespace-only evidence_quote is invalid and cannot encode null.
Rendered prose is optional projection and never the sole source of truth.
The ledger directory routes access but never owns ledger content or a unified database.

cz_decision_points.recommendation: Use a slot-derived chapter-fact lineage plus monotonic draft revision before handover; let C11 own chapter_id plus revision_no after handover; add stable local entry refs that are not fact IDs.
must_not_default: array position as permanent entry identity

cz_decision_points.recommendation: Whole-package submission plus per-item states; ordinary low-impact items may be batch-confirmed, high-impact items require individual signing, unresolved items remain unconfirmed.
must_not_default: whole-package submission equals every fact confirmed

cz_decision_points.topic: C11 native content and rendered prose compatibility
cz_decision_points.recommendation: Add a native chapter-fact content kind to C11 and keep rendered prose as an optional revision-bound attachment; do not automatically materialize native chapters as C1 text truth.
must_not_default: serialize structured payload into C11 text
let a projection overwrite native chapter-fact truth

cz_decision_points.topic: T14 closeout as a handover gate
cz_decision_points.recommendation: Require an explicit closeout receipt before handover; full_check references a current completed result, while any skip route must remain an explicit author choice with its own receipt.
must_not_default: unknown overlays change eligibility or original judgments

cz_decision_points.recommendation: Keep the C11 revision as saved but unmapped; do not use automatic deletion as compensation. A dedicated deletion policy, if desired, is a separate product decision.

task_cards.title: Formal chapter-fact draft owner, revisions, and local entry identity
task_cards.objective: Turn the existing immutable prototype into a restart-safe AuthorWorkspace asset without reusing WORK_DRAFT prose semantics or allocating chapter/fact IDs.
inputs: current CHAPTER_SLOT_SNAPSHOT
current M11 chapter-fact material bundle snapshot
author-authored ordered fact_text and separate writing_note values
operation_id
expected current draft revision and payload SHA for edits
outputs: formal chapter-fact draft object with a slot-derived lineage
monotonic draft revision and current/stale read result
stable local entry ref per fact sentence, distinct from fact_id
source plan/slot/facts/bundle watermarks
canonical payload SHA and replay receipt
author-readable current draft page

save.logical_content: current chapter-fact draft plus revision metadata and operation receipts

happy_path: create r1, edit to r2, restart and read exact bytes
reorder unchanged entry refs without changing fact identity
exact operation replay produces zero extra revision
failure_and_race: stale expected revision has zero writes
source plan/slot/bundle changes during guarded commit have zero writes
same operation ID with different payload is rejected
all-whitespace fact_text is rejected
recovery: crash before pointer yields complete before state
crash after pointer yields complete after state

forbidden_changes: Do not rename or reuse WORK_DRAFT as the chapter-fact object.
Do not allocate chapter_id, revision_no, or fact_id.
Do not normalize or rewrite author fact text.
Do not fill missing title/time/identity with defaults.
Do not write C11, facts, planstore, actual, or handover state.
remaining_boundary: C11 identity does not exist until DLH-03/DLH-05.
Retention of historical pre-handover draft payloads remains a product storage policy.
This card does not decide fact confirmation.
acceptance: A current chapter-fact draft can be saved, edited, restarted, read, and declared stale without any prose WORK_DRAFT identity.
Every fact sentence has a local stable ref, but no global fact ID exists yet.

task_cards.title: M11 role firewall and T14 adapter for unhanded chapter-fact drafts
task_cards.objective: Bind the existing M11 current-fact/future-plan split and T14 semantics to the exact current chapter-fact draft revision.
inputs: current formal chapter-fact draft from DLH-01
M11 bundle with current_fact_pack and planning_supply roles
provider judgments only through the existing controlled result interface
optional author unknown adjudication action
full_check closeout action referencing an exact result
outputs: chapter-fact T14 input package with prior-fact, future-plan, and draft-entry zones
completed check result bound to draft ref/revision/payload SHA and source snapshots
author change view preserving four evidence states
unknown self-reported overlay that leaves the original judgment unchanged
full_check closeout preflight/receipt that does not claim all-clear

save.owner: T14 check result owner and unknown overlay owner

consumers: explicit handover preflight according to CZ-04

happy_path: covered/mismatch/missing/unknown/unplanned all remain distinguishable
missing null quote, unknown null quote, unknown exact quote, and ordinary exact quote render distinctly
full_check accepts completed result with findings
unknown adjudication survives restart and parent remains unknown
failure_and_race: empty and whitespace quote are rejected
draft edit after check makes result stale
plan/facts/bundle watermark change makes result stale
provider cannot inject identity, scope, completed status, or replacement content
recovery: same unknown action replays with zero write
corrupt overlay or result SHA fails closed

forbidden_changes: Do not let future plans enter prior-confirmed-fact zone.
Do not interpret covered as fact confirmed or actual.
Do not interpret completed/full_check as all-clear.
Do not rewrite an unknown judgment after author adjudication.
Do not use empty strings as null evidence.
Do not perform handover or close chapter.
remaining_boundary: Whether closeout is mandatory before handover is CZ-04.
Severity/blocking policy is not frozen by this card.
No real model quality claim follows from schema tests.
acceptance: T14 checks only an exact current unhanded chapter-fact draft.
All four evidence states are author-readable and mechanically unambiguous.
Result/overlay/closeout remain separate objects with zero truth writes.

task_cards.title: C11 native chapter-fact content adapter and optional rendered-prose attachment
task_cards.objective: Keep one stable C11 chapter revision chain while allowing external text revisions and native structured chapter-fact revisions without treating rendered prose as truth.
inputs: current formal chapter-fact draft ref/revision/payload SHA
author-confirmed INITIAL title using scheme A: single-line, trimmed, non-empty, and not inferred/defaulted
existing C11 ledger state or proof that INITIAL target is new
optional rendered-prose projection bound to an exact native revision
outputs: C11 native chapter-fact revision representation
immutable structured payload reference and source draft reference
C11-owned stable chapter_id and formal revision_no only at successful commit
optional rendered-prose attachment with renderer identity and paragraph-to-entry provenance
read adapter for M7/M9/M11 and exports

save.owner: C11 chapter revision ledger plus immutable native payload/attachment owner
save.native_lane: native payload ref is primary; rendered prose is optional attachment

happy_path: external C10 text revision still validates byte-for-byte
native INITIAL receives one C11 chapter_id and r1 only during commit
native REPLACE appends revision under same chapter_id
render attachment is optional and can be regenerated without C11 revision change
paragraph provenance points to existing local entry refs
failure_and_race: structured payload serialized into text fields is rejected
render source revision mismatch is rejected
caller-supplied chapter_id/revision_no is rejected
leading/trailing whitespace or multiline INITIAL title is rejected
native route cannot create C10 material
recovery: C11 append is before-or-after complete within AuthorWorkspace
restore creates a new revision rather than moving current backward
unknown payload SHA enters manual recovery

forbidden_changes: Do not put native structured content into C11 text_sha256/chars/C10_SOURCE_SPAN.
Do not require rendered prose for a native chapter.
Do not let render edits overwrite native payload or facts.
Do not route native content through C10, M2, or M3.
Do not create a second chapter ID owner.
remaining_boundary: Exact C11 schema version and field names require CZ-03 and contract review.
C1 compatibility behavior remains a product decision.
Rendered prose quality and model selection are outside this card.
acceptance: One C11 chain can identify external-text and native-chapter-fact revisions without semantic overloading.
A native revision is usable when no rendered prose exists.
Rendered prose cannot become the sole source of truth.

task_cards.title: Native fact admission with whole-package submission and per-item states
task_cards.objective: Admit native chapter-fact entries into the fact owner without extraction, while preserving per-item author control and downstream invalidation.
inputs: committed or prepared C11 native chapter-fact revision
ordered local entry refs and exact fact_text values
author package submission action
per-item decisions or pending markers
current facts snapshot and expected version/SHA
outputs: fact admission plan with one owner-generated fact record per eligible entry
AUTHOR_ATTESTATION/native-chapter source identity tied to C11 revision and entry ref
per-item status manifest
batch confirmation receipts for ordinary items
individual receipts for high-impact items
deterministic migration effects for unchanged/changed/deleted entries

save.atomic_scope: one facts snapshot replacement per batch; phase-A coordinator may include prepared admissions in the same AuthorWorkspace commit

consumers: M6 evidence/query with visible author-attestation source

happy_path: whole package submits once while each entry retains its own status
ordinary entries batch-confirm in one facts commit
high-impact entry requires separate explicit signature
unresolved entry remains invisible to M6/M8/M11
author-attested native fact is queryable without a fabricated prose anchor
failure_and_race: caller cannot supply fact IDs
one invalid item keeps the whole admission/batch at zero writes
stale C11 revision or facts SHA rejects before write
package submission cannot silently confirm pending entries
writing_note never becomes a fact
revision_and_invalidation: unchanged entry ref and text preserve status
changed text returns only that entry to re-confirmation and stales direct dependents
deleted entry leaves history but exits current
re-confirming a fact does not silently resurrect stale reconciliation edges

forbidden_changes: Do not call M2, M3, or the M4 extraction path.
Do not label native entries extracted unless CZ explicitly broadens that status semantics.
Do not treat package submission as every fact confirmed.
Do not fabricate text anchors or quote evidence for author-attested facts.
Do not let the model submit review actions or fact IDs.
Do not leave a partial batch.
remaining_boundary: Initial neutral status name and high-impact taxonomy require CZ-02.
Long-term deletion/withdrawal policy is separate from ordinary reject/reconfirm.
Cross-store plan reconciliation is DLH-06.
acceptance: Native facts enter through author-controlled admission with zero extraction calls.
Every entry has an independent status and visible source identity.
Only confirmed current items reach downstream consumers.

task_cards.title: AuthorWorkspace phase-A native handover commit
task_cards.objective: Commit the native chapter revision and fact admission state inside AuthorWorkspace only, then expose an honest planstore-pending operation.
inputs: current chapter-fact draft and exact payload SHA
explicit author handover action with a scheme-A title validated as single-line, trimmed, and non-defaulted
current T14 closeout receipt according to CZ-04
prepared C11 native revision
prepared per-item fact admission/status plan
expected AuthorWorkspace owner versions/SHAs
outputs: C11 native chapter revision and current chapter index entry
owner-generated stable chapter_id and formal revision_no
facts snapshot containing per-item admission/status results
chapter handover operation at AW_COMMITTED_PLANSTORE_PENDING
receipt containing immutable chapter/facts/source watermarks
author-visible pending status
consumers: M7/M9/M11 only after HANDOVER_COMPLETE unless a reader explicitly asks for saved-unmapped content

happy_path: native INITIAL commits one chapter revision, facts manifest, and pending marker
exact replay after restart is zero-write
next native chapter receives a distinct owner-generated chapter identity without overwriting the prior chapter
author page clearly says saved but plan handover pending
failure_and_race: draft/title/check/facts changes before commit produce zero writes
planstore remains untouched on every phase-A failure
same operation ID with different handover payload is rejected
caller-supplied IDs or timestamps are rejected
recovery: crash before AuthorWorkspace pointer recovers to all-before
crash after pointer recovers to complete pending after-state
partial owner state or unknown SHA fails closed

forbidden_changes: Do not write planstore in phase A.
Do not claim cross-store atomicity.
Do not route native content through C10, C1 text, M2, or M3.
Do not mark HANDOVER_COMPLETE before a verified planstore receipt.
Do not hide the pending chapter or delete it on later plan failure.
remaining_boundary: Pending content is saved but not yet handed over to planning.
This card does not map slots or open the next chapter.
Cancellation behavior after this commit is CZ-05.
acceptance: A successful phase A leaves a fully valid AuthorWorkspace after-state and exactly zero planstore writes.
The operation is visibly AW_COMMITTED_PLANSTORE_PENDING and restart-safe.

separate AuthorWorkspace HANDOVER_COMPLETE acknowledgment
derived recovery/author-visible status

happy_path: phase B maps an existing chapter without creating C10/C11/facts
phase C records exact plan receipt and HANDOVER_COMPLETE
exact replay after restart writes neither store
M8 can open the next chapter only after completion policy passes
crash_points: crash after phase A before B leaves visible pending
crash during B recovers planstore to complete before or after
crash after B before C is detected by receipt query and only C is retried

forbidden_changes: Do not pass chapter-fact content, title, or paths to planstore.
Do not let planstore allocate chapter_id or C11 revision.
Do not delete or roll back the AuthorWorkspace chapter when planstore fails.

Chapter-close hard gates remain a separate product workflow.
A completed handover does not prove every per-item fact is confirmed.

The author can distinguish saved-pending, plan-committed-ack-pending, manual recovery, and complete.
No code path claims cross-store atomicity.
